description: Atlético 2–0 Man Utd, the trip to Leeds, the footballers who score AND create, front threes face off, Barça's record bid, Vinícius banned, Sydney FC's trophy cabinet, an 11-goal half in Sweden, tables, the Rugby League World Cup and Fortnite's last update of the season.
